meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 能帮你浏览、选择并提交 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上的实验方案，包括蛋白表达纯化、RNA 合成、检测分析等，还能用 EstiMate 评估自定义方案。
howto.when: 当你想在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上运行蛋白表达、RNA 合成、检测分析等实验，或需要评估自定义方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交一个细胞-free蛋白表达HiBiT检测的方案。
say.note: Claude 会引导你选择协议并填写参数。

say.text: 用EstiMate评估一下我的自定义蛋白纯化流程。
say.note: Claude 会帮你描述需求并获取可行性报告。

say.text: 我想做IVT mRNA合成，需要什么输入？
say.note: Claude 会列出该协议的输入要求和步骤。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can help you browse, select, and submit protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, including protein expression/purification, RNA synthesis, assays, and use EstiMate for custom workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to run experiments on Ginkgo Cloud Lab (e.g., protein expression, RNA synthesis, assays) or need to evaluate a custom protocol via EstiMate.

say_en.text: Submit a cell-free protein expression with HiBiT quantification.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through protocol selection and parameter entry.

say_en.text: Use EstiMate to assess my custom purification workflow.
say_en.note: Claude will help describe the workflow and get a feasibility report.

say_en.text: What inputs are needed for IVT mRNA synthesis?
say_en.note: Claude will list the required inputs and steps for that protocol.
